title: E. Howard Hunt links JFK's death to UFO inquiries
summary: Jesse Michels tells of E. Howard Hunt links JFK's death to UFO inquiries, about 1963 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.difference: Says Hunt told this to his son and puts it more strongly, as 'killed over UFOs', not 'partially' because of his inquiries.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of E. Howard Hunt claiming that JFK's 1963 death was linked to UFOs.

related.note: The same deathbed confession by Hunt, but Levenda says only that Hunt admitted knowing of a conspiracy to kill Kennedy, with no UFO motive.

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels has told several times how E. Howard Hunt, a former CIA operative who claimed a role in events around President Kennedy's 1963 killing, linked that killing to UFOs. In some versions Hunt told his son, and in others he told a man named Douglas Caddy, who kept asking him what the murder was really about until Hunt said "the alien presence", possibly near Hunt's death, as the interviewer Dark Journalist reported it. If true, it would mean a president died partly over questions about UFOs.
